subject: SOC 2 / SIG: Onboarding & Offboarding artifacts request
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: AuditsOps <audits@fjord-analytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 / SIG: Onboarding & Offboarding artifacts request

Hi Maya / Fjord team,

Thanks for the heads up on the assessment scope. We can definitely compile the employee onboarding/offboarding artifacts you requested. To confirm the exact deliverables you need from Redwood:

- Background check policy + a sample of completed (redacted) checks covering hires and applicable contractors
- Training completion roster for Security & Data Handling for the last 12 months
- Onboarding checklist matrix showing role-based access grants and timing (HRIS + Okta evidence)
- Offboarding / deprovisioning tickets and timeline examples (SSO, GCP, internal apps)
- Recent access review exports (last 12 months) and owner attestation logs

Can you confirm whether you need full PII in samples (we will redact where required) and whether contractor onboarding (1099 / vendor contractors) is in-scope? We aim to get a consolidated package to you by Tue Nov 24 EOD PST if that works.

Jordan Blake
Director, Cloud Ops
Redwood Inference
(jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com)

Attachments: onboard_matrix_v1.xlsx (stub), training_roster_Q3_2026.csv (stub)

From: Maya Liu <m.liu@fjord-analytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AuditsOps <audits@fjord-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 12:07:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / SIG: Onboarding & Offboarding artifacts request

Jordan — thanks for the rapid reply. A couple clarifications:

- Please include contractor (vendor) onboarding records where background checks are applicable. A 10% sample of contractor files is fine.
- PII: redact SSNs and DOBs; we need name, role, hire date, verification that check completed.
- For deprovisioning we specifically want at least two ticket examples showing the ticket lifecycle and timestamps (created -> revoked -> verified).
- Access review: export of Okta (or similar) admin reports for the last 12 months is sufficient; CSV is preferred.

Your timeline of Tue Nov 24 EOD PST works. If you hit any blockers with redaction or legal approvals, flag us and we can accept a partial set on the 24th with the remainder by Nov 30.

Regards,
Maya Liu
Senior Security Assessor
Fjord Analytics
m.liu@fjord-analytics.com

Subject: Re: SOC 2 / SIG: Onboarding & Offboarding artifacts request

Jordan / team — I can own assembly of the HR-origin assets. Proposed plan:

1) Priya will pull the background check outputs and produce a redacted CSV with the columns Maya requested (name, role, hire_date, check_type, check_completed_date). We will remove SSN/DOB and maintain an internal unredacted source in our HRIS for auditors under NDA.

2) I'll export the training completion roster from our LMS and include completion timestamps and certificate IDs where available.

3) Marcus — can you export two deprovisioning tickets (one involuntary leaver, one contractor end-of-engagement) and the Okta 'user_deprovision_history' report? Please ensure we note the timeline for keys/credentials revocation.

4) Jordan — can you create the consolidated Drive folder and a one-page index (artifact_index.md) listing each item and access instructions for the auditor?

I expect the redacted background CSV and training roster by Mon EOD (Nov 22) and the Okta exports + tickets by Tue morning. We should be able to deliver the consolidated package to Fjord on Tue Nov 24 as requested.

Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: hr_onboarding_notes.txt (stub)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Nov 2026 10:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / SIG: Onboarding & Offboarding artifacts request

Thanks — I pulled two representative deprovision tickets and exported the Okta deprovision history. Quick notes:

- sample_deprovision_ticket.txt (attached stub) shows ticket creation 2026-06-03 14:02 UTC, deprovision actions performed 2026-06-03 14:45 UTC, and verification by IT Ops 2026-06-03 15:10 UTC.
- okta_user_deprovision_history.csv (will attach) contains user_id, username, deprovision_time, initiated_by, affected_apps.
- Privacy constraint: the Okta export includes several fields that are PII. I will redact email addresses for contractor accounts where required before we hand off. We should also include a short attestation line from IT that revocation workflows are automated via our deprovision playbook.

Drive link to prep folder (internal access only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_onboarding-artifacts

Marcus Lin
Senior Platform Security Engineer
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: sample_deprovision_ticket.txt (stub)

Laura / Jordan — completed the redacted background export and uploaded the file to the prep folder. Summary: 342 records pulled, 32 contractors included, 10% contractor sample flagged per Maya's request. Files uploaded to prep folder: background_checks_redacted.csv, training_roster_Q3_2026.csv, onboard_matrix_v1.xlsx.

I left a notes file in the folder (redaction_readme.md) describing which columns were removed and the internal retention path for unredacted files. I will coordinate with Legal if Fjord requests the unredacted originals; we will require their signed NDA and a scoping memo.

Priya Natarajan
